name: Tex-Mex Pasta Salad with Shrimp, Cucumber & Bell Pepper (Two Ways)

ingredients.name: raw shrimp, peeled & deveined, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: This recipe was created to feed two adults and two young children. You know your child (their tastes and appetite) best. Use this recipe as a template, adjusting ingredients, cooking methods, and portions as needed.

Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap). Add salt, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, uncover, add pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain and rinse under cold water to cool.

Meanwhile, if using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: 454 g raw shrimp, peeled & deveined, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add shrimp, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring often, until opaque, 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, using a clean colander, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ lime
1 English cucumber
1 jalapeño pepper
½ small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Place yogurt, mayo, and spices in a medium bowl, then whisk to combine the dressing. Transfer a ¼-cup to a small bowl and set dip aside for the kids plates.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup plain Greek yogurt
¼ cup mayonnaise
¼ tsp garlic powder
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Juice lime into the bowl with the dressing and whisk once more to combine.
Trim and seed bell peppers. Slice half of a pepper lengthwise into thin strips and transfer to a plate. Cut remaining bell pepper into bite-sized pieces and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim cucumber. Slice one-third crosswise into thin rounds and add to the plate with the bell pepper strips. Cut remaining cucumber into bite-sized pieces and add to the bowl. Set plate aside.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Small dice and add to the bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Finely grate Parmesan. Set a ¼-cup aside for the kids plates, then add remaining Parmesan to the bowl.
Set aside 1-cup of cooled pasta for the kid plates, then add remaining pasta to the bowl and stir to combine the salad.

FOR THE KID PLATES: Divide plain pasta, bell pepper, cucumber, dip, and a portion of cooked shrimp between plates. Top pasta with reserved Parmesan.

FOR THE ADULT PLATES: Divide the pasta salad between plates, top with remaining shrimp, and enjoy!
